verdict.rationale: Convex's docs state the backend can run on your own servers, using the open-source backend with the same up-to-date code as the cloud service. The official GitHub repo adds that self-hosted Convex works with Postgres, SQLite, RDS, Neon, Fly.io and others, and documents operational controls such as the --disable-beacon flag. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, detailed setup/operations guidance in the evidence (e.g. Docker/install steps, upgrades), explicit statement of feature parity with cloud-only items like dashboard and log streaming.
